description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseStorageService' that implements temporary storage functionalities for the OpenMRS project, including handling of temporary file creation, data saving, key encoding/decoding, and integration with stream-based data services.

classes.name: BaseStorageService
classes.description: An abstract service class providing temporary storage operations, including file handling, key encoding/decoding, and integration with stream data services within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getTempData
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary data InputStream based on a provided key, throwing an IOException if the file does not exist.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Overloaded methods to save data streams or writers with optional metadata and module/group identifiers, returning a generated key.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Saves an InputStream as a temporary file on the filesystem, returning its filename.

methods.name: decodeKey
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded key string into a human-readable form using UTF-8.

methods.name: encodeKey
methods.description: Encodes a key string into a URL-safe format, replacing certain characters for safe URL inclusion.
